A familiar engine. More room to create.

This workspace uses the actual OpenStrandStudio strand objects, layer loading, masks, attachment circles, and Qt drawing through the MxN desktop rendering pipeline.

Animal markers use the original local PNG assets and endpoint pairing logic. Toggle them independently of strand labels; the preview and PNG export use the same renderer.

The renderer runs on your computer. Keep it running while using this site. JSON exports preserve the OpenStrandStudio history format. Continuation opens after generating a starting stitch. Its angle ranges, pair extensions and alignment use the original MxN code. GPU batch workflows remain in the desktop app.
